text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent heart attack and sudden umbilical pain with bloody stools, I am concerned about a potential blockage of blood flow to your intestines. Has the pain remained constant, or does it come and go in waves, and do you have any history of atrial fibrillation or irregular heart rhythms?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain. I also have Bloody loose bowel movements, No vomiting, Sudden onset. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Migraine and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: A migraine diagnosis is clinically inconsistent with your severe abdominal pain and bloody stools, especially given your recent myocardial infarction. speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
